description: Shared Mini paths that ignite-email-infra deploy-poller.sh stages and activates. Hermes-agent records ownership here; mutation is owned by ignite-email-infra actors in production_mutation_registry.json.

cron_schedule_authority.notes: Schedule authority lives in Hermes fleet jobs.json once aligned; live Mini cadence reconciled back to */15 on 2026-08-03 (the */45 cadence recorded 2026-08-01 was scheduler drift, not an intended change; runbook and contract expect */15). Skip escalation SLA is ~45 minutes (three missed fires).

runtime_lock.behavior: Held across the atomic activation shell so cron cannot observe torn renames mid-deploy.

paths.role: verified rollback snapshots selected by deploy-poller.sh rollback
hash-verified live poller entrypoint installed by deploy-poller.sh
live poller config (no secrets; env-backed mailbox passwords)

shared_production_write_lease.acquire_call_site: deploy-poller.sh remote activation shell — fcntl LOCK_EX on ~/.hermes/state/purelymail-poller/.lock before staging renames (implementation PR in ignite-email-infra; Hermes shared lease acquire/release to wrap the same resource id)
shared_production_write_lease.release_call_site: deploy-poller.sh remote activation shell — lock fd closed on successful activation or explicit rollback completion
